caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing against a plain, light background. The figure is wearing a voluminous, ankle-length, off-white or cream-colored dress with a fitted bodice and puffed sleeves. The neckline is wide and decorated with lace, and the cuffs of the sleeves are finished with matching lace trim. The waist is cinched with a wide belt of the same off-white color. The skirt of the dress is full and rounded, embellished with lace along the hem and three large, circular rosettes spaced along the lower skirt. The figure's hands are gloved in the same off-white color as the dress. The face is pale with light-colored lips and small, dark eyes. The hair is blonde and mostly hidden under a pink and green headscarf or bonnet, which is decorated with fabric flowers or bows. There are no other objects or background elements in the drawing. The artist's signature "C. VARY" appears in small writing at the bottom left corner.
title: Costume Doll
